d:
Dilli pulis ke mukhyalay ke bahar somvar, 2 navanbar ko dilli pulis ke kuchh adhikariyon ne virodh pradarshan kiya. iske bad ve mukhyalay ke andar dakhil hue aur dharne par bhi baithe. puliskarmi do adhikariyon ke tabadle ke khilaf pradarshan kar rahe the. inka tabadla vakilon ke virodh pradarshan ke bad huaa tha. janie aakhir ye pura mamla kya hai?
Riport: tim bibisi nyuz hindi
